messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED — streaming tail latency spike for /v1/stream (p99 > 10s). Pagered to rotation. ticket=INC-2026-042
Cameron S: acked, I'm oncall. checking dashboards and alert details.
Maya R: seeing p95 ~1.2s but p99 jumped to ~11s starting 06:02 UTC. error rate is low, mainly long tail.
Devon L: I can see repeated upstream timeouts in proxy logs and a few 502s. pulling tcpdumps now.
Eve Ops: nginx shows `upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream` on proxy-23.
Cameron S: are we sure this is stall vs dropped chunks? any client backpressure signs?
Maya R: traces show long pauses between sent chunks (pause ~20-30s) for streams longer than ~60s. not full disconnects.
Paul (support): customers reported UI streaming stalls — 3 enterprise tenants impacted, degraded UX. notifying account teams.
Devon L: starting tcpdump on host-23-rt. applying quick mitigation: increase proxy read timeout to 120s and reload. command: `kubectl -n redwood exec proxy-23 -- sed -i 's/proxy_read_timeout 60s/proxy_read_timeout 120s/' /etc/nginx/conf.d/stream.conf && nginx -s reload`
Cameron S: also try disabling proxy buffering temporarily, and Maya can we reduce runtime batch max-delay to flush tokens faster?
Maya R: patching runtime to reduce continuous batch max-delay from 50ms -> 10ms for streaming routes. will canary to 1 pod.
infra-bot: deploy started: runtime/canary-rt-1 -> 10.2.4.5
Cameron S: @Paul, please DM affected customers with ETA ~15m for mitigation.
Paul (support): sending templated message now.
Devon L: proxy change (timeout + `proxy_buffering off`) applied. monitoring.
Eve Ops: after proxy changes, p99 on the host subset dropped from ~11s -> ~2.4s. still occasional spikes around ~6s.
Maya R: canary patched pod shows p99 ~1.1s for streaming. starting rollout to 30% (3 pods).
infra-bot: rollout: runtime -> 3/10 pods updated
Devon L: still seeing `write: broken pipe` in runtime logs from clients that don't negotiate chunked transfer well. adding explicit `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` header for now.
Cameron S: long-term fixes: keepalive pings (websocket) + explicit SSE heartbeat chunking in runtime; add client compatibility tests. that's for postmortem/RFC.
Paul (support): one tenant still sees UI hiccups, account team escalated. others acknowledged mitigation.
Maya R: after 30% rollout, global p99 down to ~1.3s and p95 stable around ~0.9s.
Cameron S: leaving follow-ups: 1) postmortem, 2) proxy buffering/timeout runbook, 3) runtime flush tuning + tests, 4) client compatibility matrix. handing off to Day SRE @Devon L for post-incident. handoff in 10m.
Devon L: taking over. I'll open the incident ticket, collect traces, and schedule postmortem. tagging eng-runtime, eng-sre, devex.
Eve Ops: also check autoscaler behavior — CPU on runtime pods spiked during stall windows. might be correlated.
infra-bot: incident status update: mitigated (partial). next update in 1h or on-change.
Cameron S: thanks all — reassigning rotation to Devon L. :wave:
Devon L: ack. starting metrics collection and synthetic monitor creation for token-level streaming latency. adding alert: p99_streaming > 5s for 3m. attaching quick log sample:
```
2026-03-14T06:03:12Z stream_id=abc123 evt=chunk_sent bytes=512
2026-03-14T06:03:42Z stream_id=abc123 evt=chunk_sent bytes=0 delay=29.8s
2026-03-14T06:04:10Z upstream=proxy-23 err=upstream timed out while reading response header
```
Paul (support): following up with customers, will reopen if they see regressions.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED — status: Mitigated (fallbacks + runtime patch) | severity: Sev2 | assignees: Devon L
Devon L: creating follow-ups: synth monitors, postmortem doc, RFC for SSE heartbeat + client compatibility tests.
Eve Ops: request DevEx to publish compatibility guidance for clients that mishandle chunked transfer encoding. include versions seen in logs.
Maya R: adding a regression eval to Optimize so batching suggestions avoid long-lived client stalls.
Cameron S: good work team. closing my shift. :thumbsup:
